$comment: The Min download of the same 3.0 bundle as `bundle/v3-full.json`: the same sixty-nine names and paths (format.md §8: a level belongs to the download, never to the file name), the level stated once, every host-ready file built coarser (here a different placeholder, so its sha256 differs) and its count quartered, every georeferenced file byte-identical to the Max file. The manifest is held to the served 3.0.0 schema, a staged release, which the validator reports at info (`schema.staged`).

Basemap/Basemap.png.subject: The rendered map, for a drape

Basemap/Basemap.usdz.subject: The map's features as curves, points and polygons

Basemap/Roads.csv.subject: Road centrelines, one row per vertex

Elevation/Elevation.png.subject: Ground elevation, for a heightmap import

Site/Site.dxf.subject: The flat plan drawing, with its paper-space layouts

Site/Site.usdz.subject: The site as one model: terrain, buildings, roads, water, land use and trees, textured

files.Readme.md: A synthetic bundle for the conformance corpus. It holds no real data.
